source.notes: 5 distinct Speedway receipts (2 Traverse City MI photos, 2 CA scans, 1 CA photo; 49a1a1e7 is a duplicate of 1746d34d and was excluded). Body face is all-caps single-width on every slip; only the Michigan in-store POS prints its tender line in the double-width bold face.

store_header.notes: n=22. SPEEDWAY wordmark + address + STORE#/Ph lines are body (cap_rel med 1.026, stroke 0.96). The wordmark is plain text on the print, no logo graphic.

sale_header.notes: n=5. Standalone SALE / CUSTOMER COPY heading, body size (cap_rel med 0.931).

summary.notes: n=13. SUBTOTAL / SALES TAX / TOTAL DUE block is body weight (cap_rel med 0.919 is scan skew on the CA slips, not a smaller face).

tender_line.notes: n=7. The Michigan POS prints 'DEBIT $13.38' in a double-width bold face (6cd665ef: stroke 10.7 px vs body 6.35, stroke_rel 1.69, tier=bold). The CA slips print their Cash/CREDIT/MASTERCARD tender lines at body weight (fleet stroke_rel med 0.926); bold is the gold-receipt face.

payment.notes: n=37. EMV/auth block is body (cap_rel 1.0, stroke 1.017).

fuel.notes: n=10. Pump/grade/gallons block on the fuel slips, body (stroke 0.945).

items_sold.notes: n=1. '# ITEMS SOLD 1' measured stroke_rel 1.11 (below the 1.12 bold threshold) on a crumpled photo; kept normal.

agreement.notes: n=3. Card-holder agreement lines: cap_rel med 1.172 is the photo's bottom-of-frame perspective (the 'DON'T FORGET THE ICE' footer measures 2x for the same reason); the print is body size.

footer.notes: n=18. Now Hiring / speedway.com / THANKS FOR YOUR BUSINESS / T#.. trailer, body weight (stroke 1.0).
